tests.title: Simplified Chinese keyword finds an item with a Traditional Chinese title
tests.goal: Editors typing Simplified Chinese still find items titled in Traditional Chinese.
preconditions: An item with a Traditional Chinese title exists, e.g. one containing 財政
data: Keyword: 财政 (Simplified form of 財政)

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Search Items for 財政 and note the results count
Search Items for 财政

expected.text: The 财政 search returns the same results count as 財政

notes: 财政 -> No search results found; 財政 -> 22 results. Pending Q-003.

tests.title: Full-width Latin keyword finds items with half-width titles

preconditions: Items with "test" in the title exist

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account

tests.title: Search ignores letter case

tests.title: Extra spaces in a Chinese keyword do not change the results
tests.goal: Leading, trailing and inner spaces typed by mistake do not break a Chinese search.
preconditions: An item with 財政 in its title exists
data: Keywords: 財政, "  財政", "財政 ", "財 政"

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Search Items for 財政 and note the results count
Search Items for each variant with spaces

expected.text: Every variant returns the same results count as 財政

notes: "財政 ", "  財政", "財 政" all 22 results like 財政.

tests.title: Search with no matches shows a clear empty result
tests.goal: A search that matches nothing tells the user so instead of showing an empty or loading page.

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Search Items for qa-nomatch-<unique>

expected.text: The page shows "No search results found" within 5 seconds
The search box keeps the typed keyword

notes: Non-matching keywords (%, a<b) showed "No search results found" at once.

tests.title: Search text that looks like HTML or script finishes and is not executed
tests.goal: Pasted text with HTML tags is searched safely and never hangs the page.

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Search Items for bold
Search Items for <script>alert(1)</script>

expected.text: Each search ends within 5 seconds with a results count or "No search results found"
No alert dialog appears and the text is shown as typed in the search box

notes: bold OK; stuck on Loading Search Results 25+ s, no request sent.

tests.title: Excluding a keyword removes the matching items
tests.goal: Editors can exclude a word (NOT or minus) to narrow results.
preconditions: An item with 財政 in its title exists
data: Keywords: 財政, -財政, NOT 財政

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Open Search > Items and note the total count
Search Items for 財政 and note the count
Search Items for -財政
Search Items for NOT 財政

expected.text: -財政 and NOT 財政 return the total count minus the 財政 count
No result contains 財政 in its title

notes: -財政 and NOT 財政 both 196 (all), expected 174. Pending Q-003.

tests.title: Typing a time code jumps the player to that frame
tests.goal: Editors can go straight to a known time code in a long item.
preconditions: At least one video item of 1 hour or longer exists
data: Time code: Start TC + about 8 minutes (e.g. 10:00:00:00 for Start TC 09:51:31:20)

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Open Search > Items, sort by Media Duration and open the first video item of 01:00:00:00 or longer
Click the time code, press Enter, type the time code and press Enter

expected.text: The time code shows the typed value
The picture changes to that position

notes: 2h15m item: typed 10:00:00:00, time code shows 10:00:00:00, playhead moved to 508 s.

tests.title: Typing a time code past the end goes to the last frame
tests.goal: Out-of-range time codes do not break the player.
preconditions: At least one video item of 1 hour or longer exists

steps.text: Log in to Viz One Studio with domain Internal accounts and the VZ_ADMIN_USER / VZ_ADMIN_PASS account
Open Search > Items, sort by Media Duration and open the first video item of 01:00:00:00 or longer
Click the time code, press Enter, type 23:59:59:24 and press Enter

expected.text: The time code shows the last frame (Start TC + Duration)
The player still plays when Play/Pause is pressed after jumping back to the start
